```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var start = new Date(2022, 2, 1); // March 2022
  var now = new Date();
  var years = now.getFullYear() - start.getFullYear();
  var hadAnniversary = (now.getMonth() > start.getMonth()) ||
    (now.getMonth() === start.getMonth() && now.getDate() >= start.getDate());
  if (!hadAnniversary) years--;
  var el = document.getElementById("years-exp");
  if (el) el.textContent = years + "+";
});
</script>
```

## AI Policy

I am a proponent of using AI tools to boost productivity, as long as they
are used responsibly and transparently.

For my website, I use [Claude Code](https://claude.com/product/claude-code) 
for Quarto site configuration and writing custom HTML/CSS/JS. 
I also use Claude Code to help with coding in my personal projects. 
Usage is always attributed in commit messages and project documentation.

I do *not* use AI for tasks that reflect my critical thinking and
creative ability, such as writing blog posts or making art.
